name: take_up_thy_bed
conceit: Museum-artifact macro photography of the man's own mat against a pure black void -- never a person in frame -- so the object itself (its wear, its worn dragged corner, its final standing bundle) carries the whole 38-year weight and the whole miracle without ever needing a figure.

anti: a beat whose emotional weight is in a face, a crowd, or an event actually in progress -- this device deliberately shows nobody, only what a person left behind
a subject too young/undamaged/unused to carry visible decades of wear

plate_bill.must_contain: extreme macro of a thin ancient woven mat against pure black void, raking side-light, a faint permanent body-shaped impression pressed into the weave
extreme macro of the mat's frayed corner edge, fibers visibly thinner from being dragged repeatedly in one direction, black void, raking light
the same mat rolled into a tight bundle standing unaided on its end in black void, a faint untouched pool outline barely visible in the far negative space

motion_slots.earned_by: this device's whole thesis is stillness -- a static object against black void; no beat in it currently justifies a paid clip over the $0 macro-push camera.

beat_template.hook: macro on the mat's own permanent body-shaped wear
beat_template.pivot: the worn dragged edge, 38 years of struggle told in fiber
beat_template.landing: the mat stands alone, rolled and upright, the untouched pool no longer needed

score_shape: a single sustained low drone under the macro wear-detail, unchanged and patient, opening into one clean resolving chord only as the mat stands upright on the landing.
